hooks.command:
f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/CONTRIBUTING.md"; m="The SessionStart hook in .claude/settings.json could not deliver CONTRIBUTING.md from $f. Read it before changing anything in this repository."; out=$(jq -Rs --arg m "$m" 'if test("\S") then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("CONTRIBUTING.md for this repository, injected at session start so its review checklist is in context before the change it governs is written.

" + .)}} else {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$m}} end' "$f" 2>/dev/null) && printf '%s' "$out" || printf '%s
' "$m"
